title: Concept: Eloquent mass assignment left fully open in php — review required
description: In php, the model disables mass-assignment protection entirely. Eloquent then maps every key in the input array onto a column, so a request that adds is_admin or balance changes those fields if the controller passes the request through. The setting is usually added to make a seeder work and is never narrowed again.
applicability: php Laravel applications with Eloquent models.
risk: Privilege escalation and unauthorized field writes; MEDIUM severity.
